metadata.description: PICO Spatial MCP — vision-verified agentic toolchain for PICO OS 6 spatial development.

plugins.name: pico-spatial-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server: brief-to-verified-APK compilation for PICO OS 6 (native + WebSpatial), vision-verified honesty, splat world models with semantic labeling, agent-vault SDK validation, emulator automation, and pico-cli perf diagnosis. 251 tools on macOS / 248 on Linux are runtime-measured; Windows 248 is source-derived because no native Windows tools/list measurement has run. Installs with the curated 18-tool doors surface by default; set PICO_MCP_SURFACE=full for every tool.
